title: First Followers
summary: Get your first Threads followers from zero: find today's newcomers, creators and early big posts in your niche, draft every welcome and reply for you to send by hand, write your first three posts, and track day one - works with no post history.
triggers: i have zero followers on threads
how do i get followers on threads with no posts

inputs.name: connected account, signed-in visible browser, niche from the Brain or three short answers

outputs.name: welcome, creator and reply cards drafted for hand-sending, three first posts with approval packet and schedule receipt, local day-one scoreboard

free_capabilities: visible-browser Threads search for today's newcomers, active niche creators and early big posts (read only)
welcome, follow-and-comment and reply-up cards drafted for the owner to send by hand
local draft checker for the daily welcome cap, links, duplicates, flattery templates, DMs and specific references
local casing guard that proves lower(original) == lower(final) for every post
self-contained local day-one scoreboard served on 127.0.0.1, counts only
paid_capability_stubs: Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations

instructions: Never follow, like, comment, reply, post or DM from the browser; the owner does every follow and send by hand.
When the visible browser is signed in to a different Threads account than Threadify, stop before any search and ask the owner to switch.
When Threads search returns no fitting newcomers, creators or early posts, say so and show fewer cards; never pad with weak or off-niche picks.
Never write the three posts yourself when Threadify generation is unavailable; report the exact blocker and manual next step.
When best_time_to_post has no history for the account, say the times are general, not measured.
When a follower or post count is not readable, show it as unknown, never 0.

must_prove: account match between Threadify and the visible browser
starting follower and post counts with timestamp
card counts per move and draft checker result
day-one re-check counts and change since start
